description: This file defines functions and utilities related to handling timezone offsets in the Moment.js library, including parsing, formatting, and manipulating timezone offsets.

methods.name: offset
methods.description: Defines format tokens 'Z' and 'ZZ' for timezone offset formatting.

methods.name: offsetFromString
methods.description: Parses timezone offset from string input.

methods.name: cloneWithOffset
methods.description: Creates a clone of a moment object with a specified offset.

methods.name: getDateOffset
methods.description: Calculates timezone offset in minutes, handling Firefox-specific behavior.

methods.name: getSetOffset
methods.description: Gets or sets the timezone offset of a moment object.

methods.name: getSetZone
methods.description: Gets or sets the timezone zone offset.

methods.name: setOffsetToUTC
methods.description: Sets the offset to UTC (zero offset).

methods.name: setOffsetToLocal
methods.description: Sets the offset to local time.

methods.name: setOffsetToParsedOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset based on the parsed offset string.

methods.name: hasAlignedHourOffset
methods.description: Checks if the offset is aligned to an hour boundary.

methods.name: isDaylightSavingTime
methods.description: Determines if the current time is in daylight saving time.

methods.name: isDaylightSavingTimeShifted
methods.description: Checks if daylight saving time shift has occurred.

methods.name: isLocal
methods.description: Checks if the moment is in local time.

methods.name: isUtcOffset
methods.description: Checks if the moment has a UTC offset.

methods.name: isUtc
methods.description: Checks if the moment is in UTC.
